task.body: Add a property test in `test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs` verifying that `Tau.Settings.Loader` merge is commutative for non-conflicting keys and right-biased for conflicts, then make `mix test` pass.

implementer.diff:
diff --git a/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs b/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
index 545db4d..d6f6e2f 100644
--- a/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
+++ b/test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs
@@ -1,8 +1,27 @@
 defmodule Tau.Settings.LoaderTest do
   use ExUnit.Case, async: true
+  use ExUnitProperties
 
   alias Tau.Settings.Loader
 
+  # Generate a scalar value: string, integer, boolean, or nil.
+  defp scalar_gen do
+    one_of([string(:alphanumeric), integer(), boolean(), constant(nil)])
+  end
+
+  # Generate a flat map with atom keys that are NOT list_keys,
+  # bounded to a small key universe to make disjointness tractable.
+  defp scalar_map_gen do
+    non_list_atoms = [:model, :temperature, :timeout, :max_tokens, :name, :version, :debug]
+
+    gen all(
+          key_subset <- list_of(member_of(non_list_atoms), min_length: 0, max_length: 4),
+          pairs <- fixed_map(Map.new(Enum.uniq(key_subset), fn k -> {k, scalar_gen()} end))
+        ) do
+      pairs
+    end
+  end
+
   describe "merge/2" do
     test "later overrides earlier scalars" do
       assert Loader.merge(%{model: "a"}, %{model: "b"}) == %{model: "b"}
@@ -30,5 +49,36 @@ defmodule Tau.Settings.LoaderTest do
       merged = Loader.merge(a, b)
       assert merged[:permissions][:deny] == ["Bash(rm *)", "Bash(sudo *)"]
     end
+
+    @tag :property
+    property "merge is commutative for maps with disjoint non-list keys" do
+      check all(
+              a <- scalar_map_gen(),
+              b <- scalar_map_gen(),
+              # Ensure key sets are disjoint
+              Map.keys(a) -- Map.keys(b) == Map.keys(a) and
+                Map.keys(b) -- Map.keys(a) == Map.keys(b)
+            ) do
+        assert Loader.merge(a, b) == Loader.merge(b, a)
+      end
+    end
+
+    @tag :property
+    property "merge is right-biased for conflicting scalar keys" do
+      non_list_atoms = [:model, :temperature, :timeout, :max_tokens, :name, :version, :debug]
+
+      check all(
+              shared_key <- member_of(non_list_atoms),
+              val_a <- scalar_gen(),
+              val_b <- scalar_gen(),
+              extra_a <- scalar_map_gen(),
+              extra_b <- scalar_map_gen()
+            ) do
+        a = Map.put(extra_a, shared_key, val_a)
+        b = Map.put(extra_b, shared_key, val_b)
+        merged = Loader.merge(a, b)
+        assert merged[shared_key] == val_b
+      end
+    end
   end
 end
implementer.stdout_excerpt:
Done. The agent added two `@tag :property` tests to `test/tau/settings/loader_test.exs` and confirmed `mix test` is green:

1. **Commutativity** — generates disjoint flat maps over a 7-atom key universe; asserts `merge(a, b) == merge(b, a)`.
2. **Right-bias** — injects a shared key with independent values; asserts the merged result carries the right-hand value.

Run property tests alone with `mix test --only property`.
